name: shfl_scope
mechanisms: instruction.service SHFL.BFLY / SHFL.DOWN / SHFL.UP / SHFL.IDX issue_group_resource (b300: shfl_sm, SM scope, interval ~3.99; h100: shfl_smsp only)
question: The b300 tree binds the four SHFL classes to an SM-scope issue-group resource (shfl_sm, initiation interval ~4 cycles): every shuffle of the whole SM serialises through one unit. The binding is inherited from blackwell-prototype (mechtree.w3) and service_latency b300 r3q / v3r4 measured single-warp intervals, which cannot distinguish SM from SMSP scope. In the wo55 baseline the bw slow tail is dominated by shuffle-heavy kernels whose top resource wait is shfl_sm (FI3-CLASSIC-TOP-K-SAMPLING 1.22-1.28, resource bucket 43 % of warp-cycles, shfl_sm 114 k wait cycles; TR3-TUT-SOFTMAX 1.42; TR3-TK-TOPK 1.23). Is the shuffle issue interval an SM-wide or a per-SMSP constraint?

engine_rules_declared_before_data.S-SM (current b300): issue_group_resource shfl_sm (scope sm, 1 copy): an independent SHFL stream on n warps that sit on n distinct SMSPs runs at t(n) = n x ii per instruction per warp (ii = installed interval 3.99).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.S-SMSP (current h100): issue_group_resource none / resource shfl_smsp (scope smsp): t(n) = t(1) = max(ii, 1) for every n (one warp per SMSP).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.decision: cells: n in {1, 2, 4} warps, one per SMSP (warp w on SMSP w), each running U = 128 independent shuffles (8 rotating destination registers, shfl.sync.bfly / shfl.sync.idx), per-warp clock window; two runs. t(n)/t(1) <= 1.15 for n = 2 and 4 -> S-SMSP installed (b300 SHFL.* issue_group_resource -> none, service interval unchanged); t(4)/t(1) >= 3.4 -> S-SM confirmed (no change); in between -> record, no change. h100 must reproduce S-SMSP (control) or the run is a harness fault. Evidence measured when both runs agree within 3 %.

probe: tools/microbench/shfl_scope/probe/shfl_scope.cu: one CTA of 32 n threads (n warps -> SMSPs 0..n-1), per rep bar.sync then per-warp clock64 window of U = 128 fully unrolled shfl.sync.{bfly,idx}.b32 on d[i & 7] (lane-varying data, mask 0xffffffff), as dispatch_contention/probe/contention_v3.cu; also a dependent-chain cell (d = shfl(d)) at n = 1 to reproduce the installed result latency (b300 24 / h100 30) as a harness check. --launches 8 --reps 33, two runs. SASS gate: window = exactly U SHFL.<kind> and nothing else.
install: b300 instruction.service SHFL.BFLY / DOWN / UP / IDX: issue_group_resource -> 0xFFFFFFFF (none) with source shfl_scope.b300.r1; issue_interval_cycles unchanged (the per-SMSP interval the single-warp cells measured); tree build && validate --strict; CTest + pytest; 500 x 2 A/B against wo55 (bw expected to move, hp unchanged).
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no threshold change after data.
